engine: v2 crawl + basic checks + 5 function testers

plan.summary: ShopLite is a simple online shop where customers browse products, add items to a cart, manage orders, and maintain their account. The demo should showcase the core shopping loop: browse → product detail → add to cart → cart, plus the auth and order-management flows.

demo_journeys.name: Log in to ShopLite
steps: Navigate to the Log in page
Enter email (bob@shoplite.test) and password
Click the Log in button
Confirm you are taken to the Shop page as Bob Tester

demo_journeys.name: Browse, view a product, and add it to the cart
steps: Land on the Shop page and note the product grid with sort control
Click the Desk Lamp ($45.00) card to open its detail page
Read the description and click 'Add to cart'
Follow the link to the Cart page and confirm the item and total are listed

demo_journeys.name: Review and manage orders
steps: Open the Orders page from the top navigation
Locate order #1000 (1 item, $45.00)
Show the Delete control (do NOT click it in the demo)

demo_journeys.name: Account settings
steps: Open the Account page
Verify email (bob@shoplite.test) and display name are shown
Optionally edit the display name and click Save to confirm persistence

demo_journeys.name: Browse, view a product, and add it to the cart
steps: Land on the Shop page and note the product grid with sort control
Click the Desk Lamp ($45.00) card to open its detail page
Read the description and click 'Add to cart'
Follow the link to the Cart page and confirm the item and total are listed

demo_journeys.name: Review and manage orders
steps: Open the Orders page from the top navigation
Locate order #1000 (1 item, $45.00)
Show the Delete control (do NOT click it in the demo)

demo_journeys.name: Account settings
steps: Open the Account page
Verify email (bob@shoplite.test) and display name are shown
Optionally edit the display name and click Save to confirm persistence
